items.text: The schema definitions and route/lifecycle document account for every assigned scope item and identify proposal targets, relied-on basis, origin, lifecycle/outcome standing and receipt/view information without an unsupported wire/storage decision. Verified by VER-001.

verification.text: Review OUT-001 and OUT-002 against the twelve SCOPE rows, HOST V4-HI-20–25 and the input contracts; validate the produced schemas using their declared representation when agreed, inspect representative records, and record any deferred representation choice with its owner and point of need. Evidence: source-to-definition coverage, schema validation result and explicit open-choice account.

items.text: Equivalent human, embedded and external change cases use one named host validation/application route and yield equivalent outcome/error meanings, including invalid or stale refusal; no fixture authorizes a separate agent mutation path. Verified by VER-002.

verification.text: Exercise matched human, embedded and external contract cases for the same operation/basis and applicable authority, including invalid and stale inputs; compare validation/application route identity, errors and outcome meaning. Evidence: channel comparison tied to the contract candidate, with test-double versus actual host evidence stated.

items.text: The contract and fixtures leave domain truth and validation with the host and do not upgrade an agent result to a host-accepted result when the host act is absent. Verified by VER-003.

verification.text: Inspect the storage/authority and accepted-result definitions, then exercise an agent result without a recorded host act. Evidence: host-ownership map and negative acceptance case preserving the result's actual standing.

items.text: Agent-origin cases retain the originating conversation/workflow-run attribution and the exact relied-on catalog basis through request and outcome association. Verified by VER-004.

verification.text: Exercise agent-change examples through request and outcome association and compare origin, conversation, workflow run and basis to the originating input. Evidence: attributed request/outcome records and exact basis comparison against the catalog contract.

items.text: The lifecycle specification and fixtures distinguish drafted, validated, queued, accepted, applied with receipt, rejected, withdrawn and stale, while the direct-autonomy case records no invented human acceptance. Verified by VER-005.

verification.text: Inspect the lifecycle transition specification and exercise its success and rejected/withdrawn/stale branches plus a granted-direct-application case. Evidence: transition observations with applied receipt references and absence of invented human acceptance in the direct case.

items.text: Cases with unobservable proposal/application outcomes report unknown whether execution occurred or not; a lost observation supplies no inferred success, failure or human act. Verified by VER-006.

verification.text: Exercise unobservable-outcome cases for both an executed operation with lost observation and an operation whose application is not established. Evidence: unknown-outcome reports and the actual observation limits, without inferred state.

items.text: An intervening change invalidating the relied-on basis produces stale refusal with a reason, and a re-drafted proposal is explicitly based on the current basis. Verified by VER-007.

verification.text: Change the basis after drafting, submit the prior proposal, inspect its refusal reason, then inspect re-drafting on the current basis. Evidence: original/current basis identities, stale response and separately identified re-draft.

items.text: Changing the host selection after drafting never changes the proposal's bound targets or the affected objects reported by the contract. Verified by VER-008.

verification.text: Draft for identified objects, change selection, and submit/inspect the proposal. Evidence: original and later selection context compared with unchanged bound targets and reported affected objects.

items.text: Repeating submission of the same proposal, including after an acknowledgment is lost, yields only one application effect; unverifiable outcome remains unknown rather than being manufactured from the repeat. Verified by VER-009.

verification.text: Submit the same identified proposal repeatedly, including a retry after a lost acknowledgment, and compare the application effects and receipt/outcome observations. Evidence: effect count and actual host/test-double receipts demonstrating one effect; retain unknown where observations cannot establish the outcome. Record the implementation scope actually exercised without asserting an untested global exactly-once guarantee.

items.text: Host-view contract cases contain the proposal's old values, new values, affected objects and reason, and identify the external host as the view/receipt producer. Verified by VER-010.

verification.text: Review proposal-view schema examples and the host receiving responsibility map against V4-HI-24. Evidence: old/new values, affected-object and reason coverage plus host ownership; a live UI witness is separate host-owned evidence.

items.text: Success responses alone establish execution and imply no acceptance, approval, checked or professional-reliance standing; each claimed human act is supported by actual evidence of that specific act, and one act does not establish another. Verified by VER-011.

verification.text: Exercise successful operations without human-act evidence and cases where one actual human act is evidenced independently of the others; compare each response claim with evidence of that specific act. Evidence: execution-only success responses and separately evidenced acceptance, checking, approval and professional-reliance claims, with no act inferred from another.

items.text: Submission cases report queued until host acceptance and application are recorded; accepted-only, successful-submit and lost-observation cases do not claim applied, while observed application links the host receipt. Verified by VER-012.

verification.text: Exercise submitted/queued, host-accepted-only, recorded accepted-and-applied, and interrupted-observation cases; compare consumer reports with actual host records. Evidence: queued until acceptance/application, applied receipt linkage when observed, and unknown when the outcome cannot be observed.

items.text: The policy interface distinguishes routine permission, granted direct application, proposal acceptance and other human acts, preserves OI-001/OI-002 as unresolved at their stated points of need, and supplies no fabricated human act or blanket approval policy. Verified by VER-013.

verification.text: Review the adopted-policy interface and representative direct/proposal/routine-permission/human-act descriptions against CLM-004, DECISIONS #d3 and ISSUES OI-001/OI-002. Evidence: operation-level distinctions, actual adoption references where available, and named unresolved policy choices without a substituted rule.

items.text: Every excluded act in REQ-013 resolves to its named contribution and cited ownership claim, and the schema/document/fixture scope retains all twelve assigned scope items without claiming sibling or external implementation, adoption or joined-witness completion. Verified by VER-014.

verification.text: Review each REQ-013 excluded act one-for-one against CLM-002–CLM-005 and the accepted deliverable/external-owner rows; run the registered boundary-owner checker and manually resolve any NOT_CHECKABLE or NO_CITED_CLAIM result. Evidence: owner/claim mapping, all twelve scope items retained, and no unsupported implementation/adoption/witness claim.
